title: An invoice keeps its term and due date when the customer is moved
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held only by customer {Customer-A}, who has an invoice {Invoice-A} dated Oct 5, 2026, due Oct 25, 2026, showing Terms {Term-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-01c N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-01c Customer and {Invoice-A} is the invoice of work order S2-15448.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 60" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Open {Invoice-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the window opens with {Customer-A} ticked.
  • Step 3: the dropdown shows Net 60.
  • Step 4: the toast "1 customer moved to Net 60." shows.
  • Step 5: it still shows Terms {Term-A} and Due date Oct 25, 2026 (Oct 5 + 20 days).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R7: “An invoice keeps the term and due date it was created with. Changing the customer's term later, deactivating the term or moving the customer never changes an existing invoice.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
